observation_summary: The system throws a ClassCastException or fails assertions when retrieving default values for double primitives because it returns an Integer instead of a Double.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an incorrect entry in the `primitiveValues` map within the `Primitives` utility class. Specifically, the entry for `double.class` was mapped to an integer `0` instead of a double `0D`. This caused type mismatch errors (ClassCastException) and assertion failures in tests expecting a double value when the framework attempted to retrieve default values for primitive types.
